parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the UPnP IGD-PCP Interworking Function for this PCP Client.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the UPnP IGD-PCP Interworking Function for this PCP Client. {{enum}} The {{enum|Error}} value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

object.description: Properties for the interworking function between UPnP IGD (Internet Gateway Device) and PCP, as specified in {{bibref|RFC6970}}.
